posts.title: Recovering Legacy S3QL Filesystems from AWS S3
posts.description: Before I fully understood the operational lock-in and caveats that come with S3QL, I deployed several encrypted, deduplicated filesystems directly on Amazon S3.

posts.title: American Multitudes
posts.description: A reflection on polarization sparked by identity and automated blocklists. A challenge to the comfort of digital isolation and advocates for the difficult, necessary work of engaging with neighbors to bridge cultural divides.

posts.title: How to sell open source software to the government
posts.description: A three-step roadmap for open source entrepreneurs to win government cannabis traceability contracts. It offers philosophical and strategic ideas on championing open technology for the public good.
